view: AP portable, pediatric frontal chest (marked "AP PORTABLE", L marker on image right = patient's left)
technical_quality: Suboptimal: portable AP film with marked tilt/rotation of the image, low lung volumes, mandible and scapulae overlapping the apices, slight patient rotation; penetration adequate; both costophrenic angles included but the right base is partly obscured by an ECG electrode; AP magnification of the mediastinum expected

laterality_sources.bbox: right, middle zone (324x319 px box, radiologist localisation)
laterality_sources.reader_a: bilateral overall; dominant/most conspicuous infiltrate right, middle-lower zone
laterality_sources.reader_b: bilateral overall (blind); dominant/most conspicuous infiltrate right, perihilar and basal
laterality_sources.adjudicator: right, middle zone extending into the lower zone and perihilar region; milder left perihilar/lower-zone involvement recorded as an additional finding

devices.type: Tracheostomy tube (round flange en face, cannula projecting over the upper trachea, tip well above the carina)
devices.zh: 氣切管（頸部正中，尖端位於上段氣管）

devices.type: ECG electrode with lead wire (rectangular clip)
devices.location: Patient's right shoulder / right upper chest soft tissue
devices.zh: 心電圖電極及導線（右肩／右上胸）

devices.location: Patient's right lower lateral chest, over the right lower zone / hemidiaphragm
devices.zh: 心電圖電極及導線（右下胸，鄰近右橫膈）

devices.location: Patient's left mid chest, lateral to the heart border
devices.zh: 心電圖電極及導線（左中胸）

devices.location: Patient's left lower chest / costal margin near the left hemidiaphragm
devices.zh: 心電圖電極及導線（左下胸／肋緣）

devices.type: Thin tubular line of uncertain nature (central venous catheter vs enteric/feeding tube vs external lead wire)
devices.location: Right paramediastinal, from the right neck/shoulder region descending along the right mediastinal border toward the diaphragm
devices.zh: 右側縱膈旁細管狀影（中央靜脈導管、餵食管或體外導線，性質不確定）

devices.type: Small rectangular metallic snap/clip (external artifact, e.g. tracheostomy tie fastener or gown snap)
devices.location: Patient's left supraclavicular soft tissue, lateral to the trachea
devices.zh: 左鎖骨上方小金屬扣（體外物）

devices.type: External tubing (probable IV line or lead wire), outside the thorax
devices.location: Lateral to the patient's left arm at the image edge
devices.zh: 左臂外側影像邊緣體外管線（點滴管或導線）

other_findings: 左側肺門周圍及左下肺野較淡之斑片狀浸潤（雙側受累，右側為主）
心縱膈影偏大、邊緣性心臟肥大（AP 投照、旋轉及低肺容積之放大效應需納入考量）
肺容積偏低，支氣管血管紋理擁擠
右側橫膈邊緣部分模糊，右肋膈角疑似輕度鈍化／少量肋膜積液（受電極遮蔽，不確定）
長骨及肋骨纖細、呈骨質減少樣表現，提示慢性病或長期臥床病童
未見氣胸、大量肋膜積液或胸管
suitability_reason: 右側中下肺野浸潤清楚可見，且無胸管或肋膜引流管；但影像上有氣切管、四枚心電圖電極及右縱膈旁疑似中央靜脈導管／餵食管，顯示為慢性病、長期依賴氣切且處於監測環境之病童，與一般首次就診情境不符。僅適合病史已載明氣切依賴（如神經肌肉疾病合併吸入性肺炎）之個案使用。
description_zh: AP 攜帶式小兒胸部X光，影像明顯傾斜旋轉且肺容積偏低，下頜與肩胛骨重疊於上肺野。頸部正中可見氣切管，胸壁有四枚心電圖電極及導線，右側縱膈旁另見一條細管狀影自頸部向下延伸至橫膈附近（中央靜脈導管、餵食管或體外導線，性質不確定），左鎖骨上方有一小金屬扣，左臂外側影像邊緣另有體外管線。右側中肺野可見範圍約 8-10 公分之斑片狀、網狀肺浸潤，向下延伸至右下肺野與肺門周圍，右側橫膈邊緣部分模糊、右肋膈角疑似輕度鈍化；左側肺門周圍及左下肺野亦有較淡之斑片狀浸潤。心縱膈影偏大、雙側肺門突出（AP 投照、旋轉與低肺容積之放大效應需納入考量），骨骼纖細呈骨質減少樣表現，未見氣胸、大量肋膜積液或胸管。
